# openai_project_model_permissions (Resource)

Manages the model allowlist or denylist policy for an OpenAI project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_project_model_permissions" "production" {
  project_id = "proj_abc123"
  mode       = "deny_list"
  models     = ["o3"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Whether `models` is an allowlist or denylist.
- `models` (Set of String) The models included in the policy. Sent to OpenAI as `model_ids`.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `object` (String) The OpenAI object type.
